evidence.title: GitHub - ardakaracizmeli/design-system-checklist: An open-source checklist to help you plan, build and grow your design system.

name: Design System Checklist
summary: Open-source checklist site for planning, building and growing a design system.
description: A community-maintained checklist that walks teams through planning, building and growing a design system. Its content is open source on GitHub: items are proposed by pull request, must hold as a standard across multiple well-known design systems, and each carries reference links.
contains: open-source checklist for planning, building and growing a design system
items contributed via pull requests, each with reference links
built as a Next.js site with pages and src folders
